from PIL import Image

print("global mean RGB:", row.mean(axis=0).round(1))

from PIL import Image
import numpy as np
a = np.asarray(Image.open('barcode.png').convert('RGB')).astype(int)[0]
lum = a.mean(axis=1)
# black run at end
i = 999
while lum[i] < 8: i -= 1
print("black starts at x =", i+1, "-> credits length:", 999-i, "stripes")
# black at start
j = 0
while lum[j] < 8: j += 1
print("initial black run:", j, "stripes")
# fraction of very dark stripes
print("frac lum<25:", (lum<25).mean().round(3), " frac lum<40:", (lum<40).mean().round(3), " frac lum>120:", (lum>120).mean().round(3))
# hue distribution
import colorsys
hs = []
for r,g,b in a:
    h,s,v = colorsys.rgb_to_hsv(r/255,g/255,b/255)

    print(name, m)
# bright stripes
bright = np.where(lum>115)[0]
print("bright stripes:", bright.tolist())
for i in bright: print(i, '#%02x%02x%02x'%tuple(a[i]))
